title: POLI 491: U.S. Security Policy
topText: Analysis of Trump’s Executive Order Against Tiktok
subheader2: Best Undergraduate Paper in Political Science 2021/2022
bottomText: An exploration of the justications for President Trump's use of the Executive Order to ban the use of Tiktok in the United States.

title: POLI 477: American Politics
topText: Evolution of Twitter Usage of House of Representative Candidates
bottomText: An exploration of how U.S. House of Representative candidates used Twitter (now X.com) during the 2020 election campaign. In particular, with regards to changes in usage since 2012.
